memory_candidates.content: When converting a formerly-unconditional blocking predicate into an evidence-gated one that must still surface the suppressed case loudly, materialize the candidate list once and derive BOTH selections from it rather than re-scanning. In this repo's orchestrate-batch-admit.sh the pattern is: build $overlaps (the full annotated overlap list, with the blocking/idle discriminator computed as a key on each element), then $hit = first blocking member and $idle_advisory = first suppressed member. This preserves the original first-match/ascending-order determinism for both, avoids a second invocation of the expensive overlap predicate, and keeps the untouched disjunct (in_batch) bit-for-bit identical because the comprehension body is copied verbatim with only the new discriminator key added.
